graph500.source: M4-16 audit (docs/research/dashboard-ux-audit.md): default graph ready on the generated 500-file fixture took 563-720 ms over three runs; the slowest is the baseline.

fullGraph2000.source: M4-20: the M4-16 dashboard (fa31104) measured with its own audit on this machine on 2026-11-02: Full Codebase on the generated 2,000-file fixture settled in 7,059, 7,132 and 8,414 ms (median 7,132 ms), in one main-thread task of about 6 s.
